question:
I have a dbt python model in my folder foo

 |-foo
 | |-post_to_api.py
 | |-test_post_to_api.py
 | |-foo.sql

How can I exclude all my python tests when I do dbt run?

dbt run --models foo --exclude foo.test_post_to_api
 
  Parsing Error in model test_post_to_api (models/geronimo/test_post_to_api.py)
  dbt allows exactly one model defined per python file, found 0

Or should I put my unittests in another location?
title: dbt python models and unitests
answer:
Add .py files to a .gitignore file in the root directory (i.e. the same as dbt_project.yml. For instance:

.gitignore

**.py

When dbt executes it will still copy over the Python models. See additional comments on this topic here.
